citation.authors: Xia Y, Cho S, Howard RS, Maggio KL
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.population: 27 men with PFB in a military population
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, paired right-neck/left-neck trial of laser hair removal plus eflornithine cream against laser plus placebo, 16 weeks
record.finding: The eflornithine side had a median hair reduction of 99.5% against 85.0% on the placebo side, with fewer inflammatory papules. Follow-up ended at 16 weeks.
record.note: Participants' ethnicity is not stated in the abstract. Eflornithine and laser are clinic or prescription treatments.
